title: [NSW] Tap Installation $150 (Was $180), Taps Supplied & Installed from $183 @ TapLife (Sydney Metro Only)
body:
Deal: [NSW] Tap Installation $150 (Was $180), Taps Supplied & Installed from $183 @ TapLife (Sydney Metro Only)

[Tutien87] Anyone used their services before can comment?
[UncleRico] Nice deal. Love a bit of ingenuity and entrepreneurship. Now to find a tap, and a need…
[Vallani] Great to see this kind of innovation and much needed competition in plumbing.
[AussieMark] Anyone recommend anyone in Melbourne
I have a few I'd like to get done
[TreefulSeed] I'd recommend jeff - 0434 332 619. Licensed Plumber in Caroline Springs, Melbourne.
[UncleRico] Ahhh, Jeff…
How is that old dunny diver?
[AustriaBargain] I did it myself, it's a little wobbly though and there's not much clearance to move a wrench under the sink.
[R3XNebular] Yea just did my parents, theirs had not been changed in 20 years. When I was rotating the elongated hex nut on the screw, the screw itself just snapped off… Had to use brute strength to remove it..
[TreefulSeed] I agree some taps are easy, some others are harder. Some that have booked in were electricians (the kitchen tap didn’t fit because of the wooden bench underneath) and a builder(special water filter). Some don’t own tools.
The older style hot, cold and spout on a basin are usually more difficult to install due to basins sinks being deep, with minimal space and corroded nuts. One specific case was when I took out my grinder and cut the spout as it was far too corroded from underneath, although probably only the second time I needed my grinder for a tap out of countless examples.
[afayd] That's what I did for my kitchen faucet and ended up wasting many hours because sometimes it's not quite the way it's shown in the videos. Then you realise you're too far into it to give up, start getting frustrated, and almost snap the whole thing off. It all worked out fine in the end and there is a satisfaction that comes with doing your own thing, but in hindsight, I would have easily given a plumber $150 to do it had I seen this deal before. Now ask me about my story on unclogging a kitchen drain…
[Ebany] I reakon YouTube causes more denied water damage insurance claims than any other source.
[Make it so] Not bad. I've paid more (in WA). Worth noting that when you buy an expensive tap with a very long warranty, it is usually conditional on being able to prove it was installed by a plumber. So it's not just a matter of "paying a plumber to save time" - it's a matter of whether you want to void your warranty.
[kashirin] Why do you need very long warranty for exactly? Worst can happen is leaking cartridge
[TreefulSeed] Installed one in Mosman recently, the tap alone cost $800 and was imported from Germany. The cartridges were around $200. 20 years warranty though, which would be important with a $800 tap.
Wouldn't recommend such an expensive tap honestly, Bunnings has a VERY similar tap like it for less than a $100, although the $800 one was heavier but I can see they still cut some corners that the Bunnings one didn't lol.
[oatmatcha] Out of curiosity, did you ask how they found you? I wonder if they're an Ozbargainer haha
[TreefulSeed] @oatmatcha: Yup! Had another booking in Mosman for a Methven tap(Around ~$500). All ozbargainers are rich!
[orin] Used tap life before when he posted the previous deal, can 100% recommend!
[Iwantthatbargain] Last time I used a plumber for fixing tap, he charged me only $100
[TreefulSeed] Honestly that's an amazing price, but for fixing leaky taps, I'd recommend WaterFix Residential from Sydney Water. $44 call out fee and they'll fix the leaks. Sponsored by the government who pays for it as a leaky tap is wasted water.
Reason I charge $150 is that diesel is close to $3. Typical day for me is travelling from Campbelltown to Hornsby, to parramatta to Marrickville etc. Simply not sustainable to go below $150 as travel time is hours… :(
[locks-gibbous] Wait are you based in Campbelltown? We’re looking for a good plumber in Narellan / Oran Park
[TreefulSeed] Based in Villawood, 2163. If you see any services on the website, feel free to book or contact me.
[PercyKK] Yeah it's rough with the fuel costs, would a tradie consider ev van? May cut down travel cost significantly
[TreefulSeed] Ev vans sound great, they’re just way above my budget. Cheapest is around $60k.
I simply bought a Hyundai iload, which was what I could afford. Nice big van, drives and that’s good enough.
[ippy] Wow that's a lot of driving. Don't tradies (esp sole traders) target a specific area generally? Serving Sydney Metro seems quite generous tbh (that much driving would drive me nuts personally, even if I was paid for it).
[TheThunderer] Ive got a leaky tap and its probably a cartridge change. So if I got the replacement cartridge myself, I'm guessing you wouldnt get them to come out and change the cartridge for $44 and the gov sponsor the rest?
[TreefulSeed] Sydney Water do replace cartridges. The water fix website says “Flick mixers, ceramic cartridge taps, quarter-turn mixing taps
As quoted + callout fee”
The “as quoted” probably refers to the cartridge being different costs, as you’ve got it already, they should be able to do the whole thing for $44($16.50 for pensioners)
[Ebany] It's no longer the 90's, prices have changed.
[jamestas] I think I'm showing my age - are we really at the stage where we can't install our own taps? Next we will be getting people in to replace washers….
[TreefulSeed] I've got a mate that doesn't even have a screw driver lol. Nice guy, just doesn't know the tools. Then there's sweet grandpa and grandma who can't crouch under the sink/basin for back problem. Also, some taps are genuinely hard, I don't think many people would know how to replace the copper tee piece underneath the 3 piece tap set, measuring and cutting and bending the copper to suit the basin, buying their own set of copper cutters; but I may be wrong…
[Melbourne Mama] Agree. I thought of replacing sink mixer myself. But went with a local plumber. The old tap was really hard to remove. Every job has it's own difficulties.
[A Banana4scale] If your trap leaks, insurance won’t cover it unless it was installed by a licensed plumber.
[Ebany] There's legal and insurance reasons.
People can replace washers, jumpers, etc without a plumbing licence, depending on what state or territory they live in, however disconnecting a tap from the water source outside of an emergency is almost always illegal without a licence.
Lives had to be lost for people to work out it's a bad idea to let any random person play with the water source we all drink from.
[Ebany] To clarify: is that price per tap or per tap set?
[TreefulSeed] Per tap set.
Hot, Cold and spout is $150 for the whole set for installation.
1 mixer is $150 for the whole set.
[Bluey123] Do you do filter taps for drinking in the kitchen too?
[TreefulSeed] Yes we do water filters too. Happy to install any water filter you bring if you have a specific one in mind, or you can check out our one at https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/976197 for a 7 stage system
[hasher22] I see you also have "Bring Your Own Shower Head/Rails".
I would like my bathroom tap and shower head/heals replaced. Is there a deal for the two?
Located Sydney Inner West
[TreefulSeed] Shower head and rails are $180. They take a bit longer and involve drilling through the tile, which carries a higher risk. But rest assured, we’ve never had any problems after completing countless shower rails as it’s our 2nd most popular.
2nd shower rail is $100 only, so both bathrooms would be slightly cheaper in one visit.
